text: This report recommends approval of travel expenses for two staff, Nancy Kloek, Senior Event and Meeting Coordinator and Matthew Buckles, Senior Facility Coordinator to attend the first year and the second year respectively of the International Association of Venue Managers (IAVM), Venue Management School (VMS).

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Authorized travel expenses for Nancy Kloek, Senior Event and Meeting Coordinator and Matthew Buckles, Senior Facility Coordinator to attend the International Association of Venue Managers School in Tampa, Florida from June 8 to June 13, 2024, at a cost not expected to exceed $6,500 plus HST for flights, accommodation, and incidental expenses per registrant.
